# Panorama test initialization reaches component registration through the account manager

Fresh complete eleven-file registration patch and all changed harness/startup-test hunks read. Registration moves from MailGlue into account-manager initialization under MOZ_PANORAMA plus the preference. The xpcshell helper triggers MailServices.accounts before fetching the core, eliminating its duplicated manual registration. The startup performance denylist exemption is conditional on Panorama, not a general permission for early service loads. The historical constructor adds a self-reference and calls Startup after component registration changes; components.conf no longer names an init_method. Fixed source retains the unusual self-reference/factory but moves Startup to an explicit account-manager call and uses the startup StaticPref. The selected factory returns the core through its explicit void-pointer assignment; this inspected special implementation is not a general factory/ownership recommendation or proof of complete lifetime safety. Fixed account initialization still ignores Startup's own nsresult before checking old rv; the existing focused result-gap lesson is reused rather than duplicated. The review's rejected AddRef attempt and later author build-system report are historical revision discussion; final Git still contains NS_ADDREF_THIS. Acceptance and landing with failed/ongoing builds are not new build, startup or shutdown execution.

Scope: Panorama account-manager registration and test setup.
